Public saunas in Bozeman, MT

Bozeman has a small but growing public sauna scene: a downtown bathhouse inspired by the Slavic banya, an outdoor sauna and cold plunge club on the Northside, and a long-running hot springs facility west of town with a dry sauna and steam room alongside its pools. Umvelt sells two-hour sessions, PORTAL runs bookable sessions on a credit system, and Bozeman Hot Springs sells day admission at the door. Prices, hours and session formats change, so confirm with each venue before you go.

3 venues, each checked against the venue's own website on 2026-11-11. Fields we could not confirm are marked Unknown. Prices and hours change, so confirm before you go.

Downtown · 22 South Grand Ave, Bozeman, MT 59715
BathhouseRussian banyaSteam room

Schedule / who
Mon and Wed-Fri 8am-9pm, Sat-Sun 9am-9pm, closed Tuesdays (venue notes hours vary by day and season). Co-ed, 18+. Reservations advised; walk-ins admitted first come, first served when space allows.
Notes
Banya-inspired bathhouse with a large high-humidity event sauna (196°F, up to 30 guests), a smaller Finnish dry sauna (185°F), a eucalyptus steam room, a cold plunge and a warm pool. Swimwear required (no underwear or street clothes). Phone-free bathhouse floor; speak softly. Two towels and body wash provided; bring a water bottle. No outside food. Massage can be booked separately. Session packs and memberships available.

Free on-site parking, first come, first served. Memberships $99-$279/month; credits work at other PORTAL clubs.

Hot springs facility with 12 naturally heated pools, plus a dry sauna and a steam room in the indoor pool area. Indoor pools are drained and cleaned nightly; the three main outdoor pools are chlorinated. Live music in the outdoor pools on Thursdays and Sundays. Also has a fitness center, cafe and campground. Accepts cash, Mastercard and Visa.
